_comment: Delta gate thresholds for the Security Gate job.
The gate fails when an observed count EXCEEDS the number recorded here. It does
not fail on the findings that already exist. The point is to block changes that
make the codebase worse, not to block on a backlog nobody can clear in one pull
request. An absolute gate on a codebase with 65 existing image CVEs would be red
permanently, and a check that is always red is one people learn to route around,
which is worse than having no check at all.
Lowering a number here is done in the SAME COMMIT as the fix that lowers it.
That way the standard only ever ratchets downward and cannot quietly drift back
up: raising a number is a visible, reviewable diff that has to be justified.
Recorded from run 31035323629 on master (commit 527d015), which is the run whose
artifacts these numbers were read from. Do not edit them by hand from memory.
